title: Throwing darts to estimate π
intro: Darts land at random on a square 2 units on a side, with a circle of radius 1 inside it. The theoretical probability of landing inside the circle is its share of the area, π/4 = 0.7854. The computer threw 5000 darts (seed 1) and 3929 landed inside: an experimental probability of 0.7858, and an estimate of π = 4 × 0.7858 = 3.1432.
